title: ASSIGNMENT – 2
subtitle: Regression Model Evaluation and Performance Analysis
name: Srikrishna O S

sections.heading: AIM
sections.paragraph: To implement a regression model for predicting a continuous target variable, evaluate its performance using multiple evaluation metrics, visualize prediction results, and analyze overfitting, underfitting, and bias-variance. The dataset used is a real-world loan-amount prediction dataset (Kaggle: Predict Loan Amount Data) containing numerical and categorical features related to loan applications, with the target variable being the loan amount sanctioned. Linear Regression is used as the baseline model, and Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net regression are used as regularized models, tuned using GridSearchCV, to control model complexity and reduce overfitting. Libraries used: pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scikit-learn.

sections.heading: LEARNING OUTCOMES
bullets: I was able to preprocess a real-world dataset by imputing missing values, encoding categorical features, and standardizing numerical features before feeding them to a model.
I understood how to split a dataset into training, validation, and test sets for proper model evaluation.
I implemented and trained a baseline Linear Regression model for a continuous target variable.
I applied Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net regularization to control model complexity and reduce overfitting.
I used GridSearchCV with 5-fold cross-validation to tune hyperparameters such as alpha and l1_ratio.
I evaluated regression models using MAE, MSE, RMSE, and R2 score on both validation and test sets.
I visualized predicted-vs-actual values and residuals to assess how well each model fit the data.
I compared training and validation error to discuss overfitting and underfitting behaviour.
